_comment: Configuration for uip maestro flow node configure <PROJECT>.flow <triggerId> --detail '<this payload>'
_cli_command: uip maestro flow node configure <PROJECT>.flow <triggerId> --output json --detail '<this payload>'

_placeholders.connectionId: UUID of the Outlook / Microsoft 365 IS connection — obtain with: uip is connections list microsoft-office-365 --all-folders --output json
_placeholders.folderKey: Orchestrator folder key for the connection — from the same connections list response
_placeholders.eventMode: 'webhooks' for Microsoft 365 email-received (connector-managed registration, isWebhookUrlVisible=false); confirm from: uip maestro flow registry get uipath.connector.trigger.microsoft-office-365.email-received --connection-id <id> --output json
_placeholders.parentFolderId: ID of the Outlook mailbox folder to watch (e.g. Inbox) — resolve with: uip is resources run list microsoft-office-365 MailFolder --connection-id <id> --output json
_placeholders.sharedMailboxAddress: Leave empty string for the primary mailbox; set to the shared mailbox SMTP address if monitoring a shared mailbox
_placeholders.filter.filters[0].id: 'from' — exact field name from filterFields.fields[].name as returned by uip maestro flow registry get or uip is triggers describe
_placeholders.groupOperator: 0 = AND — both conditions (from + subject) must match for the trigger to fire

_resolution_steps: 1a. uip is connections list microsoft-office-365 --all-folders --output json  →  pick enabled connection, capture Id
1b. uip is triggers objects microsoft-office-365 EMAIL_RECEIVED --connection-id <id> --output json  →  check byoaConnection, isWebhookUrlVisible, parameters[]
1b-2. uip is triggers describe microsoft-office-365 EMAIL_RECEIVED Message --connection-id <id> --output json  →  EventParameters (merge with parameters[]), FilterFields, OutputFields
1c. uip is connections ping <id> --output json  →  confirm Healthy=true
2. uip maestro flow registry get uipath.connector.trigger.microsoft-office-365.email-received --connection-id <id> --output json  →  confirm eventMode, filterFields, outputResponseDefinition
3. uip is resources run list microsoft-office-365 MailFolder --connection-id <id> --output json  →  resolve parentFolderId for the target inbox
4. All required params resolved (parentFolderId + filter fields from + subject); sharedMailboxAddress optional — omit or empty for primary mailbox
5. uip maestro flow node remove <PROJECT>.flow start --output json  →  remove manual trigger
uip maestro flow node add <PROJECT>.flow uipath.connector.trigger.microsoft-office-365.email-received --label 'Email Received' --position 200,144 --output json  →  note <triggerId>
6. uip maestro flow node configure <PROJECT>.flow <triggerId> --output json --detail '<this file minus _comment/_node_type/_cli_command/_placeholders/_resolution_steps keys>'
